value: FORCED-2 SURVEY CONTROL: DEEPER WAKE ARRIVES AT OLD DEADLINE

C opens one bounded listener after A's wake. B receives and relays the same survey control later in the flood. C hears B's short wake near the end of the old window, but the old implementation kept the nearly-expired deadline and stopped before B's extended payload.
A valid deeper-relay wake starts one new bounded follow-up window. It reuses the same listener and custody; it does not add a retry queue or extend the survey deadline.
